title: Multi-word snake_case tool names render with a raw underscore instead of a readable title
observed: A backgrounded bash call's body reads 'Bash_background sleep 30' (02-bashes-list.txt) and exiting plan mode reads 'Exit_plan_mode' as both the block label and the body verb (permissions/plan-approval-options run, 07-plan-approved.txt) — only the first character is capitalized, leaving the underscores in place.
expected: A readable title like 'Bash Background' / 'Exit Plan Mode', consistent with single-word tool names ('Bash', 'Read', 'Task') which already render cleanly.
design_ref: internal/tui/transcript.go:157-163 MapToolName calls titleCase(id), and titleCase (internal/tui/bridge.go, ~line 1310) only upper-cases the first rune of the whole string — it does not split on '_' or title-case each word
